content: Diagram A.2 (Ibn Turka's intellectual network, updating Binbaş) sets Ṣāʾin al-Dīn Turka (d. 1432) at the centre with these nodes: Ṣadr al-Dīn Turka; Kātibī (d. 1436); Fażl Allāh Astarābādī; Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī (d. 1397); al-Malik al-Ẓāhir Barqūq (r. 1382-99); Shaykh Bedreddīn (d. 1416); ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Bisṭāmī (d. 1454); Iskandar Mīrzā (r. 1409-14); Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh (d. 1433); Qāsim-i Anvār (d. 1433); Qāżīzāda Rūmī (d. 1432); Sirāj al-Dīn al-Bulqīnī (d. 1403); Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī (d. 1454); Niʿmat Allāh Valī (d. 1431). Arrow direction is influence and line thickness closeness; the arrows and thicknesses are not recoverable from the extracted text.
